name: Moz
description: Give your AI Moz SEO data: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score and Brand Authority, backlinks, linking domains, anchor texts and top pages, ranking keywords, and keyword volume, difficulty and suggestions from the Moz API.
instructions:
## Moz
This connector calls the **Moz API** (`https://api.moz.com/jsonrpc`, JSON-RPC 2.0) with the user's own API token: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score and Brand Authority, backlinks, linking domains, anchor texts and top pages from the Moz link index, ranking keywords, and keyword volume, difficulty and suggestions.

**Data calls use rows of the user's monthly Moz API quota.** One row is usually one returned item (a link, a domain, a keyword) or one value; each tool says what it uses. The free plan has only 50 rows a month, paid plans more (moz.com/api/pricing); some plans bill overages. `moz_get_quota` and `moz_get_async_result` are free. Keep `limit` small (defaults 10 to 20), check the quota before large lists, and tell the user before spending many rows.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign up for the Moz API at https://moz.com/api (separate from Moz Pro; the free plan needs a credit card but is not charged).
2. Open the Moz API dashboard at https://moz.com/api/dashboard and create an API token (up to 5 per account).
3. Paste it into `MOZ_API_TOKEN` and install. It is sent in the `x-moz-token` header, only to api.moz.com.

**Tools**
- `moz_get_quota`: rows used and left this month (free; also the connection check).
- `moz_site_metrics`: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score and link counts of one site (1 row).
- `moz_site_metrics_multiple`: the same for up to 50 sites (1 row each).
- `moz_brand_authority`: Brand Authority of a domain (1 row).
- `moz_list_links`: backlinks of a site or page (1 row per link).
- `moz_list_linking_domains`: linking root domains (1 row per domain).
- `moz_list_anchor_texts`: anchor texts used to link to a site (1 row per anchor).
- `moz_list_top_pages`: strongest pages of a domain (1 row per page).
- `moz_list_ranking_keywords`: keywords a site ranks for in the top 50, US, UK, Canada and Australia only (1 row per keyword).
- `moz_count_ranking_keywords`: number of ranking keywords per position (1 row).
- `moz_keyword_metrics`: volume, difficulty, organic CTR and priority of a keyword (up to 4 rows, 5 with intent).
- `moz_keyword_metrics_multiple`: the same for up to 50 keywords (up to 5 rows each).
- `moz_keyword_suggestions`: start a keyword suggestion job (1 row per suggestion), then
- `moz_get_async_result`: collect it by id (free).
- `moz_list_locales`: locales the keyword tools accept (no rows).

**Sites and scope**: site tools take `query` (moz.com, blog.moz.com, moz.com/blog or a page URL) and `scope` (domain, subdomain, subfolder or url). When Moz reads the input differently it returns `site_query_suggestion`; follow it. List tools return `next_token`; pass it back as `next_token` for the next page, until it is empty.

**Keyword markets**: keyword tools take `locale` as a Google hl-gl pair (en-US, de-DE, it-IT ...); `moz_list_locales` lists them. Ranking keyword tools only cover en-US, en-GB, en-CA and en-AU.

**Common errors**
- 401 (-32651): the token is wrong or was deleted. Create or copy it again at https://moz.com/api/dashboard. Moz blocks an IP for 30 minutes after 10 failed logins in 5 minutes, so do not retry a refused token in a loop.
- 403 (-32670): not enough quota left this month; check with `moz_get_quota`.
- 400 (-32652): a parameter is invalid; `data.key` names it. 404 (-32655): Moz has no data for that site or keyword.
- 429 (-32658, -32650): rate limited. Wait and retry once; keyword suggestions allow 100 requests a minute across all Moz users.

**Out of scope here**: Moz Local (locations, listings, reviews), Moz Pro campaigns, SERP fetching, competitor and link intersect methods, beta methods and the older Links API v2.

MOZ_API_TOKEN.label: Moz API token
MOZ_API_TOKEN.help: moz.com/api/dashboard: create or copy an API token. The Moz API is a separate subscription from Moz Pro; its free plan has 50 rows a month.
MOZ_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the API token exactly as the Moz API dashboard shows it, without spaces or a header name.

verifyHints.401: Moz refused the API token: it is wrong or was deleted. Copy it again from https://moz.com/api/dashboard. Do not retry many times: Moz blocks the IP for 30 minutes after 10 failed logins.
verifyHints.403: The Moz API account has no quota left for this period. Check the plan at https://moz.com/api/dashboard.
verifyHints.429: Moz is rate limiting requests from this server. Wait a few minutes and verify again.

prerequisites: A Moz API account (separate from Moz Pro) and an API token from moz.com/api/dashboard. Data calls use rows of the monthly quota (the free plan has 50 rows); the quota check is free. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: moz_get_quota
tools.description: Check the Moz API quota of the current billing period: rows allotted and used, when it resets and whether overages are enabled. Free: uses no quota. Also the connection check.

path.description: Which quota: api.limits.data.rows (default, used by all tools here), api.limits.beta.rows (beta methods) or api.limits.mozscape.rows.

tools.name: moz_site_metrics
tools.description: Get Moz metrics of one site or page: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score, link propensity, linking root domains, external and nofollow link counts, pages crawled, title, HTTP status and last crawl date. Uses 1 row of quota. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, subfolder, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

tools.name: moz_site_metrics_multiple
tools.description: Get Moz metrics (Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score, linking root domains, link counts) for up to 50 sites or pages in one call, e.g. to compare competitors. Uses 1 row of quota per returned site. Read-only.

site_queries.description: Up to 50 sites, each {"query": "moz.com", "scope": "domain"}; scope is domain, subdomain, subfolder or url.

query.description: Domain, subdomain, folder or page URL.

tools.name: moz_brand_authority
tools.description: Get the Moz Brand Authority score (1 to 100) of a domain: how strong its brand is in search, to benchmark against competitors. Uses 1 row of quota. Read-only.

tools.name: moz_list_links
tools.description: List backlinks pointing to a site or page: source page and domain with their Domain Authority, Page Authority and Spam Score, target page, anchor text, nofollow, redirect and canonical flags, first and last seen. Uses 1 row of quota per returned link (up to 50 per call). Page with next_token. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, subfolder, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

sort.description: Order of the links, highest first. Default source_page_authority.

link_scope.description: page returns every link (Moz default); subdomain or domain only the best link from each source subdomain or domain.

filters.description: Only links matching all of these, e.g. ["external", "follow"]. With more than one filter, external must be one of them.

limit.description: How many links to return, 1 to 50. Default 10; each returned row uses one row of quota.

next_token.description: next_token from the previous answer, to get the next page. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: moz_list_linking_domains
tools.description: List the root domains that link to a site or page, with their Domain Authority, Spam Score and link propensity and how many of the target's pages each one links to. Uses 1 row of quota per returned domain (up to 50 per call). Page with next_token. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, subfolder, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

sort.description: Order of the domains, highest first. Default source_domain_authority.

filters.description: Only domains matching all of these, e.g. ["external", "follow"]. With more than one filter, external must be one of them.

limit.description: How many linking domains to return, 1 to 50. Default 10; each returned row uses one row of quota.

next_token.description: next_token from the previous answer, to get the next page. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: moz_list_anchor_texts
tools.description: List the anchor texts other sites use to link to a site or page, with the number of external root domains and pages using each. Uses 1 row of quota per returned anchor text (up to 50 per call). Page with next_token. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, subfolder, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

limit.description: How many anchor texts to return, 1 to 50. Default 10; each returned row uses one row of quota.

next_token.description: next_token from the previous answer, to get the next page. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: moz_list_ranking_keywords
tools.description: List the Google keywords a site or page ranks for in the top 50, with ranking page, position, difficulty and monthly search volume. Only for en-US, en-GB, en-CA and en-AU. Uses 1 row of quota per returned keyword. Page with page_number. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, subfolder, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

locale.description: Google market of the rankings: en-US (default), en-GB, en-CA or en-AU; Moz has ranking data for these four only.

sort.description: Order of the keywords. Default rank.

limit.description: How many keywords to return, 1 to 500. Default 20; each returned row uses one row of quota.

page_number.description: Page to load, 0 for the first (default), 1 for the next and so on.

tools.name: moz_count_ranking_keywords
tools.description: Count the Google keywords a domain, subdomain or page ranks for in the top 50, in total and per position 1 to 50. Only for en-US, en-GB, en-CA and en-AU. Uses 1 row of quota. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain, url. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

locale.description: Google market of the rankings: en-US (default), en-GB, en-CA or en-AU; Moz has ranking data for these four only.

tools.name: moz_list_top_pages
tools.description: List the strongest pages of a domain or subdomain by Page Authority, linking root domains or external links, with title and HTTP status. Uses 1 row of quota per returned page (up to 50 per call). Page with next_token. Read-only.

query.description: The site to look up: a domain (moz.com), subdomain (blog.moz.com), folder (moz.com/blog) or page URL.

scope.description: How to read query: domain, subdomain. Default domain. A wider scope than the URL shortens it, e.g. moz.com/blog with domain becomes moz.com.

sort.description: Order of the pages, highest first. Default page_authority.

status_filter.description: Only pages whose last crawl returned this HTTP status. Default all.

limit.description: How many pages to return, 1 to 50. Default 10; each returned row uses one row of quota.

next_token.description: next_token from the previous answer, to get the next page. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: moz_keyword_metrics
tools.description: Get Moz keyword metrics for one keyword in a market: monthly search volume, difficulty, organic CTR and priority, optionally search intent. Uses up to 4 rows of quota (5 with intent); metrics Moz has no value for are not charged. Fails with not found when Moz has no data for the keyword. Read-only.

locale.description: Market as Google hl-gl pair, e.g. en-US (default), de-DE, it-IT, en-GB. moz_list_locales lists the supported ones.

device.description: Device of the search. Default desktop.

vicinity.description: Optional place to search from, e.g. New York, NY. Leave out for national results.

include_intent.description: Also return search intent (1 more row of quota). Default false.

tools.name: moz_keyword_metrics_multiple
tools.description: Get Moz keyword metrics (volume, difficulty, organic CTR, priority and search intent) for up to 50 keywords in one call. Uses up to 5 rows of quota per keyword with data; keywords without data come back under errors and are not charged. Read-only.

vicinity.description: Optional place, e.g. New York, NY.

tools.name: moz_keyword_suggestions
tools.description: Start a Moz keyword suggestion job for a keyword: related keywords with a relevance score. Asynchronous: it returns an async_call; call moz_get_async_result with its id about 5 seconds later (again until status is complete) to get the suggestions. Uses 1 row of quota per returned suggestion. Google only. Read-only.

locale.description: Market as Google hl-gl pair, e.g. en-US (default), de-DE, it-IT, en-GB. moz_list_locales lists the supported ones.

vicinity.description: Optional place to search from, e.g. New York, NY. Leave out for national results.

strategy.description: default mixes Moz models with recent search data; related_synonyms gives semantically close keywords; related_topics keywords from related topics.

limit.description: How many suggestions to return, 1 to 100. Default 20; each returned row uses one row of quota.

page_number.description: Page to load, 0 for the first (default).

tools.name: moz_get_async_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of an asynchronous Moz job, such as moz_keyword_suggestions, by its async_call id. While status is pending or processing, wait about 5 seconds and ask again; once complete, result or error is filled. Free: uses no quota.

id.description: async_call.id returned by the job, e.g. c3397e5a-ce31-42fb-8607-ed40487aea18.

tools.name: moz_list_locales
tools.description: List the locales (hl-gl pairs such as en-US or de-DE) a search engine supports in Moz keyword tools. Uses no rows, but needs an account with Moz API row quota.
